scope: Found during production Batch 2 activation: with the Google durable execution provider selected, POST /api/swarm/execute enqueued only prompt, history, projectId, clientMeta and attachments, so a chat build into an AI Product Builder project lost its builderProjectId. The worker then ran an ordinary build with no run binding and no saved revision. Carry the already ownership-checked builderProjectId through the existing durable delivery and have the existing canonical worker open and close the Builder run. No new orchestrator, queue, table or route.

keep: The single canonical Swarm to pipeline path and the Google durable delivery
Builder ownership verification before any run, and the per-project run slot
The delivery SQL functions (p_input is already an open JSON object)
extend: CanonicalQueuedInput gains an optional UUID-validated builderProjectId
The canonical worker opens and closes the Builder run around the existing pipeline call

schemaImpact.rollout: No SQL or schema change; enqueue_google_canonical_run already accepts any JSON object input.
schemaImpact.rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy the previous image. Queued deliveries without a builderProjectId are unaffected.

auth.description: No authentication change. The id is accepted only after the verified owner matches the durable project.

tenant.description: No tenant boundary change. The worker re-verifies the project against the persisted owner when it opens the run; a body id never establishes ownership.

cost.description: No new spend path. Builds use the existing provider budget reservation.

tests.scope: Valid builderProjectId round-trips enqueue claim; malformed values are refused before any database call; the route forwards it after the ownership check; the worker opens the run before the pipeline and closes it after, with blocked/cancelled mapping. 11 PASS.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing Google durable delivery input and the existing canonical worker. No second orchestrator, scheduler or control plane.

rollout: Merge after required checks, build a source-bound release image, then update the API service and the canonical worker Job together at 0% traffic. Verify /ready, then run one authenticated build on the allowlisted test project before any traffic increase.
rollback: Send traffic back to the previous revision and restore the previous Job image. Builder projects, revisions and receipts stay.
knownGaps: Live end-to-end build proof is recorded only after deployment
Preview, QA and external delivery remain separate gates
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Batch 2 building is not accepted until a live authenticated build saves a revision

blockers: Release image build, Job and service update
